sentences.text: The Indian Penal Code vs In Re : Biplab Mondal on 7 April, 2025

Author: Suvra Ghosh
Bench: Suvra Ghosh

18
07.04.2025
Ct.No.34 b.das Rejected C.R.M. (M) 5 of 2025 In Re : An application for bail under Section 483 of
Bnss, 2023 filed in connection with Kultali Police Station Case No. 405 of 2024 dated 08.06.2024
under Sections 498A/302 of the Indian Penal Code

. 
And In Re : Biplab Mondal ... Petitioner.

Mr. Angshuman Chakraborty Mr. S. S. Saha ... for the
petitioner.
Ms. Baisali Basu Mr. Subham Bhakat ... for the State.

Mr. Ayan Mitra ...for the de facto
complainant.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is in custody for about 8 months.
Incident occurred on the spur of the moment.
Producing the case diary learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer.
Learned counsel for the de facto complainant also opposes the prayer.

It appears from the statement of witnesses including the minor child of the petitioner recorded under Section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure that the petitioner inflicted several blows upon the victim with a "da" which resulted in her death.
Material on record including the injury report of the victim also implicates the petitioner in the alleged offence.
Considering the gravity of the offence, prayer for bail is rejected at this stage.
The application for bail is thus disposed of.
Case Diary be returned.
All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
Urgent certified website copy of this order, if applied for, be supplied to the parties upon compliance with all requisite formalities.
(Suvra Ghosh, J.)
